title: Fraud Detection Service Incident Response
description: Fraud detection system incidents affecting transaction security
immediate_actions: Assess impact on transaction processing and security
Implement manual fraud review if automated system unavailable
Escalate if fraud risk is elevated
resolution_steps: Restart fraud detection services following vendor procedures
Implement model retraining if performance issues
Adjust fraud detection thresholds if needed
Coordinate with fraud analysis team for manual review
verification: Test fraud detection with sample transactions
Verify false positive rates return to normal
special_considerations: Fraud risk increases when detection systems are degraded
Coordinate with fraud analysis team for manual review
Maintain security monitoring during service restoration
Document any transactions that bypassed fraud detection
